details:
This might be out way out of VRChat plans but I guess we don't lose anything by asking.

After my coworkers found I do VR and Unity, they asked me if I could make a virtual working room (to play on desktop) where we could just chat and role play a bit.

 

After some research, I realized I would rather try something that I'm familiar with instead of learning a new different platform only to hide my VRC life from my boss LoL.

There are some good web based social VR platforms were I could build something like it but based on personal experience, I think VRChat is the most suitable one (despite not having web version or anything for it), especially if we want to do something in VR.

The only issue, is that there is a lot of friction before a user gets to understand VRChat and enjoy it, and for a one time user, is pointless. 

So I was wondering if there in the future, could be a Web Version (WebGL and GLB/glTF as fallback shader or file formats) VRChat in the future that could have some sort of "Guest Mode" for someone to get from Web Browsers, pick a temporary username and be limited to a certain Excellent rated avatars with no options to add friends nor travel to any other instance. Like a temporary isolated web based instance, like Mozilla Hubs (which shut down by the way). With basic and simplified menu and limited options.

I know it might sound a bad idea or might bring a lot of questions and possible outcomes to think of. But, it would be great to have something like it. I'm willing to pay extra for it.

I mean, imagine VRChat having a Guest Mode for quick VR events with commercial and simple short term purposes, wouldn't be cool? I could invite anyone with a smartphone or for a one time ride and not having to teach them how to play.

This could be another way to gather more non-vr or non-gamer users who could be interested in the platform afterwards and eventually become VRC+ users.

Also, world creators could list their worlds for these types of events and make extra cash, following more restricted guidelines and optimization requirements of course. 

VRChat could have a ticket event tool to generate virtual tickets like Eventbrite and make extra from those tickets.

If VRChat ever does something like this, please don't forget to add a age verification tool.

That's it. If any questions or challenges comes to mind with this idea, please comment and I will think on a possible solution for it.

(AI generated image attached)

That's it!

Thanks for reading, have a great day!

- NexVice
title: Guest Mode for VRChat and Web Version
